sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马斯。

sentences.en: Off the southeastern coast of China is the small, sweet potato-shaped island of Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 在中国东南沿海，坐落着形状像红薯的小岛——台湾。

sentences.en: Yes, I assure you, it is sweet potato-shaped, not regular potato-shaped.
sentences.zh: 没错，我向你保证，它确实是红薯形状的，而不是普通土豆的形状。

sentences.en: Taiwan is not recognized by the UN as a sovereign nation,
sentences.zh: 台湾并未被联合国承认为主权国家，

sentences.en: though many people who live there would like it to be.
sentences.zh: 尽管许多居住在那里的人希望它能成为一个主权国家。

sentences.en: Depending on who you dare ask, Taiwan could be considered a part of China, or a land apart.
sentences.zh: 取决于你敢问谁，台湾可能被视为中国的一部分，或者是一片独立的土地。

sentences.en: Before I traveled to Taiwan, I'm embarrassed to admit I wasn't entirely sure where it was.
sentences.zh: 在去台湾旅行之前，我很不好意思承认，我并不完全确定它在哪里。

sentences.en: Producer Avery Truffleman just back from Taipei, the capital of Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 制片人艾弗里·特鲁夫曼刚从台湾首府台北回来。

sentences.en: And a lot of people in Taiwan know this,
sentences.zh: 台湾的许多人也知道这一点，

sentences.en: that people like me aren't really sure where exactly they are or if they're a country.
sentences.zh: 像我这样的人并不确定他们确切在哪里，或者他们是否是一个国家。

sentences.en: And this is part of why, in 1997, the city of Taipei set out to do something they hoped would put them on the map.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么在1997年，台北市着手做一些他们希望让自己在地图上被看见的事情。

sentences.en: They set out to build a very, very tall building.
sentences.zh: 他们着手建造一座非常、非常高的建筑。

sentences.en: Taiwan really need to let the world see it.
sentences.zh: 台湾确实需要让世界看到它。

sentences.en: You know, Taiwan is such a beautiful island.
sentences.zh: 你知道，台湾是一个非常美丽的岛屿。

sentences.en: This is Michael Liu.
sentences.zh: 这是迈克尔·刘。

sentences.en: He's a representative of Taiwan's tallest building, Taipei 101.
sentences.zh: 他是台湾最高建筑——台北101大楼的代表。

sentences.en: And he says the city of Taipei started with a plan for a 66-story office building,
sentences.zh: 他说台北市最初计划建造一座66层的办公楼，

sentences.en: with a high-class mall and food court,
sentences.zh: 配有高档商场和美食广场，

sentences.en: and 66 stories was enough to make it among the tallest in the country.
sentences.zh: 而66层足以让它跻身全国最高建筑之列。

sentences.en: So then the city government said,
sentences.zh: 所以市政府说，

sentences.en: oh, you know, we should let the world see it,
sentences.zh: 哦，你知道，我们应该让世界看到它，

sentences.en: so we should have a bigger, more aggressive plan.
sentences.zh: 所以我们应该有一个更大、更激进的计划。

sentences.en: So the city of Taipei decided to change the plans,
sentences.zh: 于是台北市决定更改计划，

sentences.en: raising the building to 88 stories,
sentences.zh: 将建筑高度提高到88层，

sentences.en: which would make it the same height as the Patronus Towers in Malaysia,
sentences.zh: 这将使其高度与马来西亚的石油双塔相同，

sentences.en: which were then the tallest buildings in the world.
sentences.zh: 那在当时是世界上最高的建筑。

sentences.en: And it was not satisfied.
sentences.zh: 但他们并不满足。

sentences.en: So then one of the developers said,
sentences.zh: 于是其中一位开发商说，

sentences.en: we should go for more than 100.
sentences.zh: 我们应该争取超过100层。

sentences.en: And so they decided to make it 101 stories, hence the name Taipei 101.
sentences.zh: 于是他们决定将其建成101层，这就是“台北101”名字的由来。

sentences.en: In Chinese philosophy, 100 is a perfection.
sentences.zh: 在中国哲学中，100代表完美。

sentences.en: We're not satisfied with the perfection.
sentences.zh: 我们不满足于完美。

sentences.en: Taipei 101 rises 1,667 feet up in the air,
sentences.zh: 台北101大楼耸立在空中1667英尺，

sentences.en: which is about 508 meters.
sentences.zh: 大约是508米。

sentences.en: It is bonkers high.
sentences.zh: 它高得离谱。

sentences.en: It sticks so far above the rest of Taipei that it looks a bit surreal.
sentences.zh: 它高出台北其他建筑太多，看起来有点超现实。

sentences.en: You can see it from almost anywhere in the city,
sentences.zh: 你几乎可以在城市的任何地方看到它，

sentences.en: even from neighboring towns,
sentences.zh: 甚至从邻近的城镇也能看到，

sentences.en: like a benevolent Eye of Sauron.
sentences.zh: 就像一只仁慈的索伦之眼。

sentences.en: Building something of this size is never easy,
sentences.zh: 建造如此规模的建筑绝非易事，

sentences.en: but Taipei had extra obstacles.
sentences.zh: 但台北面临着额外的障碍。

sentences.en: In a city prone to earthquakes and typhoons,
sentences.zh: 在一个容易发生地震和台风的城市，

sentences.en: they had to design a building that could withstand these conditions.
sentences.zh: 他们必须设计出一座能够抵御这些条件的建筑。

sentences.en: And they had to convince the public
sentences.zh: 而且他们必须说服公众，

sentences.en: that this freakishly tall new building was safe.
sentences.zh: 这座高得惊人的新建筑是安全的。

sentences.en: And for a while, at least,
sentences.zh: 至少在一段时间内，

sentences.en: Taipei 101 would hold the coveted title
sentences.zh: 台北101将拥有令人垂涎的头衔，

sentences.en: of tallest building in the world.
sentences.zh: 即世界最高建筑。

sentences.en: I think it's fair to say that a large part of the story
sentences.zh: 我认为可以公平地说，高层建筑故事和历史的很大一部分，

sentences.zh: 这是安东尼·伍德，

sentences.en: executive director of the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat.

sentences.zh: 是的，我们有一把非常大的尺子，

sentences.en: Yeah, we have a very big ruler

sentences.en: No, it is all based on drawings,

sentences.zh: 因为一座高耸的建筑，

sentences.zh: 总是代表着比其自身更大的意义。

sentences.en: because a tall, tall building
sentences.zh: 从历史上看，高层建筑是企业权力的化身。

sentences.en: always represents something larger than itself.
sentences.zh: 你可以从项目的名称中看出这一点，

sentences.zh: 因此有了克莱斯勒大厦、芝加哥论坛报大厦或西尔斯大厦。

sentences.en: And you could see that in the titles of the project,

sentences.zh: 在吸引注意力和品牌推广方面，动机是一样的，

sentences.zh: 但现在它更有可能是为了一个城市、

sentences.en: but it's now more likely to be for a city,

sentences.en: like Shanghai Tower, Doha Convention Center, Dubai One,
sentences.zh: 高塔是向世界展示我们已经崛起的一种方式。

sentences.zh: 我通常被问到的问题是，

sentences.zh: 我们可以建多高？

sentences.en: The question I typically get asked is,
sentences.zh: 大多数人认为高度的限制是技术上的，

sentences.zh: 但我可以告诉你，并不是。

sentences.en: Most people think that the limits on height are technological,
sentences.zh: 实际上，塔的高度是其底座的产物。

sentences.en: and I can tell you that they're not.
sentences.zh: 只要你在塔基处有足够大的面积，

sentences.en: it's just down to structural engineering.
sentences.zh: 这意味着唯一真正的限制是资源和意愿。

sentences.en: You can go as high as you, you know, as necessary or as high as motivated.

sentences.zh: 高层建筑唯一的限制其实就是，

sentences.zh: 这是一个公私合营的项目，

sentences.en: like commercial flight patterns.

sentences.en: but also the country recognized that we need this

sentences.en: to really go for the tallest in the world.

sentences.en: And then, so the end, the flight detour.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: Oh, they pre-routed all the flights.
sentences.zh: 因为我们。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.

sentences.en: Because of us.

sentences.en: The land was set.
sentences.zh: 台北市准备建造一座，

sentences.en: The air was cleared.
sentences.zh: 将成为世界最高的建筑。

sentences.en: The city of Taipei was ready to create a building
sentences.zh: 现在他们必须让它看起来很美观。

sentences.en: that would be the tallest in the world.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，你必须把建筑设计得非常具有标志性。

sentences.en: Now they had to make it look good.
sentences.zh: 否则，你就无法成为地标。

sentences.en: to be really iconic.
sentences.zh: 当他在90年代末开始规划这个项目时，

sentences.zh: 他已经在台湾的其他城市和中国各地设计过大型建筑了。

sentences.en: That is CY Li, and he is a bona fide star architect.
sentences.zh: 他希望这座新建筑具有标志性，

sentences.en: and all around China when he started planning this project
sentences.zh: 我们模仿了更像中国宝塔的风格。

sentences.en: back in the late 90s.
sentences.zh: 所以它更像是一座高层宝塔。

sentences.en: And he wanted this new building to be iconic

sentences.en: So it's more like a high-rise pagoda.

sentences.zh: 这座宝塔被分为八个部分，

sentences.zh: 因为在中文里，“八”听起来像“发”财的“发”。

sentences.en: We pick a little bit of light green.
sentences.zh: 因为那座建筑是一座金融大楼。

sentences.en: It looks very good.
sentences.zh: 为了获得更多的好运和财富，

sentences.en: And this pagoda is divided into eight segments
sentences.zh: 建筑底座的四个侧面都有巨大的金币。

sentences.zh: 为了额外的、额外的好运，

sentences.en: And for even more luck and wealth,
sentences.zh: 角落会有很多种小东西，

sentences.en: And for extra, extra good luck,
sentences.zh: 龙是建筑的象征性守护者。

sentences.en: the corners of the tower are accented
sentences.zh: 台北101需要它能得到的所有保护。

sentences.en: with representations of clouds and dragons.
sentences.zh: 它位于我喜欢称之为“艰难街区”的地方。

sentences.en: that express the dragon.

sentences.en: The dragons are symbolic protectors of the building.

sentences.zh: 既有强风又有地震活跃地带的难点在于，

sentences.zh: 在地震中，你需要一座灵活的建筑。

sentences.en: They provided the structural engineering services on Taipei 101.
sentences.zh: 所以你真的需要一个结构良好的柔性建筑，

sentences.en: than the hurricanes we see in the eastern U.S.
sentences.zh: 这是99%隐形。

sentences.en: And it is in an active seismic zone.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马斯。

sentences.en: The tough thing about having both harsh winds
sentences.zh: 在台湾东南海岸，是小小的、红薯形状的台湾岛。

sentences.en: and seismically active ground
sentences.zh: 是的，我向你保证，它是红薯形状的，而不是普通土豆形状的。

sentences.en: is that in an earthquake, you want a flexible building.
sentences.zh: 台湾没有被联合国承认为主权国家，

sentences.zh: 尽管许多住在那里的人希望它是。

sentences.en: in an earthquake zone, kind of roll with the flow.

sentences.zh: 减轻这种晃动的方法之一，

sentences.zh: 就是使用调谐质量阻尼器。

sentences.zh: 风阻尼器或调谐质量阻尼器，

sentences.en: is basically a counterweight to winds.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是一种抗风的平衡重物。

sentences.zh: 通常阻尼器会被当作
